name: ligand_name_projection_v4
method: weight-space programming; direct algebraic weight edits without gradients or training
hypothesis: The first edit changes shared protein inputs and yields only a small development gain. Canonical SMILES atom names contain a digit in the second character, whereas standard protein heavy-atom names do not. In the input affine map, name-embedding components parallel to the three reference-coordinate columns act as atom-name-dependent coordinate offsets. Remove those components only from second-character digit columns. Preserve all reference-coordinate weights and all other feature columns. This tests whether arbitrary ligand names interfere with the geometric signal while avoiding a direct change to protein atom inputs.
